reason: With the edition and the A print in hand the reader resolved rubrics and words the first reading could not, such as 'de secretis mulierum', 'Dudum in inuicem', 'dulcissimaque' and 'theorica', and corrected 'In auctore' to 'Tu auctor'.

Source-assisted reading of Stams, Stiftsarchiv, Frg. 108 (F-mrl7), made with Harris 2007 (Google Books snippets) and the Augsburg 1518 print of Lumen anime A (MDZ bsb10202719, scan 47) in hand. Reread on the native images: canvas 1 lines 1-8 and canvas 0 lines 1-11. Canvas 0 lines 7-11 and canvas 1 lines 6-8 are weak and were not compared with a source. Expansions in parentheses; uncertain readings marked (?); [ ] = lost at the tear or illegible. Line numbers count from the top of each face.
